blocks.zh: 產品容器與密封系統
blocks.en: Product Containers and Closure Systems

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Container Closure (CC) System（容器密封系統）在污染控制策略中的關鍵角色
blocks.en: Understand the critical role of the container closure (CC) system in the contamination control strategy

blocks.zh: 掌握 Primary Container Closure（初級容器密封）的材質考量與微生物/微粒污染風險
blocks.en: Understand the material considerations of the primary container closure and its microbial and particulate contamination risks

blocks.zh: 了解 End-to-End Container Closure Integrity (CCI)（端到端容器密封完整性）的全面管控架構
blocks.en: Understand the overall control framework for end-to-end container closure integrity (CCI)

blocks.zh: 認識 CCI 從設計開發、方法驗證到製程確認的完整生命週期管理
blocks.en: Understand the full CCI lifecycle, from design and development through method validation to process validation

blocks.zh: 理解魚骨圖（Ishikawa Diagram）分析 CCI 影響因素的方法論
blocks.en: Understand how the Ishikawa (fishbone) diagram is used to analyze the factors that affect CCI

blocks.zh: 10.0 Product Containers and Closures 10.0 產品容器與封蓋
blocks.en: 10.0 Product Containers and Closures

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Container Closure System, CC System（容器密封系統）：這是藥品與外界環境之間的最後一道物理屏障。CC 系統不僅要防止微生物與微粒進入產品，還必須確保自身不會與藥品產生反應（不具反應性、不釋出物質、不吸附藥品成分）。
blocks.en: Container Closure System (CC System): This is the last physical barrier between the drug product and the outside environment. A CC system must not only keep microorganisms and particles out of the product, but must also not interact with the drug itself (it must be non-reactive, non-leaching and non-absorptive/non-adsorptive toward product components).

blocks.zh: Container Closure Integrity, CCI（容器密封完整性）：指 CC 系統在整個產品效期內維持其密封功能的能力。CCI 失敗意味著微生物有機會進入無菌產品，直接威脅病患安全。
blocks.en: Container Closure Integrity (CCI): The ability of the CC system to maintain its sealing function throughout the product shelf life. A CCI failure means microorganisms may gain access to a sterile product, which is a direct threat to patient safety.

blocks.zh: Primary vs Secondary CC（初級 vs 次級容器密封）：
blocks.en: Primary vs Secondary CC:

blocks.zh: Primary CC（初級）：直接接觸藥品，是主要的物理屏障（如西林瓶＋膠塞＋鋁蓋）
blocks.en: Primary CC: In direct contact with the drug product and serving as the main physical barrier (for example, vial + stopper + aluminum seal)

blocks.zh: Secondary CC（次級）：保護初級包裝免受物理損傷（如外盒、泡殼包裝）
blocks.en: Secondary CC: Protects the primary packaging from physical damage (for example, outer carton, blister pack)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: CC 系統就像食品的真空密封包裝。想像一包真空包裝的咖啡豆：
blocks.en: A CC system is like vacuum-sealed food packaging. Picture a vacuum-packed bag of coffee beans:

blocks.zh: 初級包裝（Primary CC）= 直接接觸咖啡豆的鋁箔袋，必須完全密封、不與咖啡豆反應、不讓空氣和濕氣進入
blocks.en: Primary packaging (primary CC) = the foil bag in direct contact with the beans. It must be completely sealed, must not react with the coffee, and must keep air and moisture out

blocks.zh: 次級包裝（Secondary CC）= 外面的紙盒，保護鋁箔袋在運送過程中不被刺破
blocks.en: Secondary packaging (secondary CC) = the outer carton, which keeps the foil bag from being punctured in transit

blocks.zh: CCI = 確保鋁箔袋從工廠到消費者手中都維持真空狀態的品質保證
blocks.en: CCI = the quality assurance that the foil bag stays under vacuum all the way from the factory to the consumer

blocks.zh: 如果鋁箔袋有微小破洞（CCI 失敗），空氣和濕氣進入後咖啡會變質。在藥品世界，這不只是品質問題——是病患安全問題。
blocks.en: If the foil bag has a tiny hole (a CCI failure), air and moisture get in and the coffee spoils. In the pharmaceutical world this is not just a quality problem; it is a patient safety problem.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 法規要求的雙重標準：CC 系統必須同時滿足兩個條件：
blocks.en: The dual regulatory standard: A CC system must meet two conditions at the same time:

blocks.zh: 不改變藥品（Inert）：不具反應性、不具添加性、不具吸附性
blocks.en: Do not alter the drug product (inert): non-reactive, non-additive and non-absorptive

blocks.zh: 保護藥品（Protective）：抵禦光線、蒸發、氣體暴露、水分吸收、微生物與微粒污染
blocks.en: Protect the drug product (protective): guard against light, evaporation, gas exposure, moisture uptake, and microbial and particulate contamination

blocks.zh: 這些要求來自 USP 和 FDA 法規（參考文獻 20），是產品申請時必須證明的基本項目。EU GMP Annex 1（2022年版）也進一步強化了對 CCI 的要求。
blocks.en: These requirements come from USP and FDA regulations (Reference 20) and are basic items that must be demonstrated in the product application. EU GMP Annex 1 (2022 version) further strengthens the expectations for CCI.

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Figure Analysis
blocks.en: Figure Analysis

blocks.zh: Figure 10.2-1🔍 魚骨圖（Ishikawa Diagram）：此圖以六大面向系統性分析影響 CCI 的所有因素：
blocks.en: Figure 10.2-1🔍 Ishikawa Diagram: This diagram systematically analyzes all the factors that affect CCI across six dimensions:

blocks.zh: Materials（材料）：容器和密封件的材質特性與相容性
blocks.en: Materials: material properties and compatibility of containers and closures

blocks.zh: Equipment（設備）：充填、壓蓋等製程設備的設計與維護
blocks.en: Equipment: design and maintenance of processing equipment such as filling and capping machines

blocks.zh: Process（製程）：製造步驟中對 CC 系統的影響
blocks.en: Process: the effect of manufacturing steps on the CC system

blocks.zh: Measurement（量測）：CCI 測試方法與規格
blocks.en: Measurement: CCI test methods and specifications

blocks.zh: Environment（環境）：儲存、運輸條件的影響
blocks.en: Environment: the effect of storage and transport conditions

blocks.zh: People（人員）：操作人員的訓練與行為
blocks.en: People: operator training and behavior

blocks.zh: Degrazio 強調：建立完善的 CC/CCI 框架可以在擴展到新產品時減少重複性研究，這對 CDMO 具有特別重要的商業意義。
blocks.en: Degrazio stresses that a well-established CC/CCI framework reduces repeated studies when expanding to new products, which is of particular commercial importance for a CDMO.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 平台化策略：對於 CDMO 而言，建立一套標準化的 CC 系統平台（例如：標準化的西林瓶規格＋膠塞＋鋁蓋組合）可以大幅降低新客戶產品導入時的 CCI 驗證工作量。一旦平台驗證完成，新產品只需進行差異性評估（gap assessment），而非完整重做所有 CCI 研究。
blocks.en: CDMO platform strategy: For a CDMO, building a standardized CC system platform (for example, a standard combination of vial specification + stopper + aluminum seal) can greatly reduce the CCI validation workload when onboarding a new client product. Once the platform has been validated, a new product needs only a gap assessment rather than a complete repeat of all CCI studies.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 CC 系統必須同時滿足「惰性」（不改變藥品）和「保護性」（防止外界因素）兩個要求？能否只滿足其中一個？
blocks.en: Why must a CC system meet both the "inert" requirement (not altering the drug product) and the "protective" requirement (guarding against external factors)? Could it meet only one of them?

blocks.zh: 如果一家 CDMO 同時生產西林瓶、預充填注射器和 IV 袋三種劑型，如何利用 Ishikawa 魚骨圖建立共用的 CCI 管控框架？
blocks.en: If a CDMO produces three presentations (vials, prefilled syringes and IV bags), how could it use the Ishikawa diagram to build a shared CCI control framework?

blocks.zh: 10.1 Primary Container Closures 10.1 初級容器封蓋
blocks.en: 10.1 Primary Container Closures

blocks.zh: Polymeric Components（高分子材料組件）：在無菌藥品 CC 系統中，密封功能的關鍵組件大多為高分子材料（如彈性體橡膠、塑膠），因為這些材料具有彈性變形能力，能夠在容器與密封件之間形成緊密接合。
blocks.en: Polymeric Components: In the CC systems of sterile drug products, most of the components critical to the sealing function are polymeric materials (such as elastomeric rubber and plastics), because their elastic deformation allows them to form a tight fit between the container and the closure.

blocks.zh: 常見的初級 CC 組件包括：
blocks.en: Common primary CC components include:

blocks.zh: Vial Stoppers（西林瓶膠塞）：丁基橡膠或鹵化丁基橡膠製成
blocks.en: Vial stoppers: made of butyl or halobutyl rubber

blocks.zh: Administration Ports（給藥口）：IV 袋上的注射/輸注接口
blocks.en: Administration ports: the injection/infusion ports on IV bags

blocks.zh: Metal Syringe Needles（金屬注射針）：不鏽鋼材質
blocks.en: Metal syringe needles: made of stainless steel

blocks.zh: Injector Pens（注射筆）：含有金屬和塑膠複合組件
blocks.en: Injector pens: contain composite metal and plastic components

blocks.zh: 初級容器密封件就像房屋的門窗密封條。門窗本身可能是金屬或木頭（硬質材料），但真正防止風雨滲入的是那層橡膠密封條（polymeric component）。密封條必須：
blocks.en: Primary container closures are like the weather seals around the doors and windows of a house. The doors and windows themselves may be metal or wood (rigid materials), but what actually keeps wind and rain out is the rubber seal (the polymeric component). The seal must:

blocks.zh: 具有彈性以填補不規則間隙
blocks.en: be elastic enough to fill irregular gaps

blocks.zh: 耐候性好，不會隨時間老化開裂
blocks.en: be weather-resistant, so it does not age and crack over time

blocks.zh: 不會釋放有害物質到室內
blocks.en: not release harmful substances into the room

blocks.zh: 同理，西林瓶的膠塞必須在與瓶口接合時產生足夠的密封力（compression force），並在整個效期內維持這個密封效果。
blocks.en: In the same way, a vial stopper must generate sufficient sealing force (compression force) when it is fitted to the vial neck, and must maintain that seal throughout the shelf life.

blocks.zh: 「understood and controlled」的深層含義：TR90 在此用語非常精確。對 CC 材料的微生物和微粒污染潛力，不只是要「管控」（controlled），還要先「理解」（understood）。這意味著：
blocks.en: The deeper meaning of "understood and controlled": The wording in TR90 is very precise here. For the microbial and particulate contamination potential of CC materials, it is not enough to "control" (controlled) it; it must first be "understood" (understood). This means:

blocks.zh: 必須了解原材料的生物負荷（bioburden）來源與水準
blocks.en: The source and level of bioburden in the raw materials must be understood

blocks.zh: 必須了解製造和滅菌過程中可能產生的微粒
blocks.en: The particulates that may be generated during manufacturing and sterilization must be understood

blocks.zh: 必須了解儲存條件對材料特性的影響
blocks.en: The effect of storage conditions on material properties must be understood

blocks.zh: 基於以上理解，才能制定有效的管控措施
blocks.en: Effective control measures can be established only on the basis of this understanding

blocks.zh: 為什麼密封組件大多使用高分子材料而非金屬材料？從材料科學的角度思考密封原理。
blocks.en: Why are sealing components mostly made of polymeric rather than metal materials? Think about the sealing principle from a materials science perspective.

blocks.zh: 對於一個 CDMO 同時處理多種容器類型（西林瓶、預充填注射器、IV 袋），在原材料進料管控上應如何區分不同的風險等級？
blocks.en: For a CDMO handling several container types (vials, prefilled syringes, IV bags), how should the risk levels be differentiated in incoming raw material control?

blocks.zh: 10.2 End-to-End Container Closure and Container-Closure Integrity 10.2 端對端容器封蓋與容器封蓋完整性
blocks.en: 10.2 End-to-End Container Closure and Container-Closure Integrity

blocks.zh: End-to-End Control（端到端管控）：這個概念強調 CC/CCI 管控不是某個單一環節的工作，而是從容器設計、材料選擇、製程開發、生產充填、到產品效期結束的完整生命週期管理。
blocks.en: End-to-end control: This concept stresses that CC/CCI control is not the job of any single step. It is lifecycle management that runs from container design, material selection and process development through commercial filling to the end of the product shelf life.

blocks.zh: Contamination Control Architecture（污染控制架構）：CC/CCI 是整個 CCS（污染控制策略）中的一個關鍵子系統，它與環境監測、人員管控、設備維護等其他子系統共同構成完整的污染防禦體系（參見 Figure 3.0-1🔍）。
blocks.en: Contamination control architecture: CC/CCI is a key subsystem within the overall CCS (contamination control strategy). Together with environmental monitoring, personnel control, equipment maintenance and other subsystems, it forms a complete contamination defense system (see Figure 3.0-1🔍).

blocks.zh: One-time Qualification（一次性確認）：對於 Drug Substance (DS) 或中間體，CCI 測試通常不需要像成品 DP 那樣進行常規測試，只需作為一次性的確認即可。
blocks.en: One-time qualification: For drug substance (DS) or intermediates, CCI testing generally does not need to be performed routinely as it is for the finished drug product (DP); a one-time qualification is sufficient.

blocks.zh: End-to-End CCI 管控就像建築物的防水工程。不是只在屋頂做防水就夠了——從地基防潮、牆面防水、窗戶密封、到屋頂防水層，每一個環節都必須完善。如果只關注其中一個環節而忽略其他，水還是會從最弱的地方滲入。CCI 同理：從材料進貨、滅菌處理、充填壓蓋、到運輸儲存，每個環節都可能是弱點。
blocks.en: End-to-end CCI control is like waterproofing a building. Waterproofing the roof alone is not enough: from damp-proofing the foundation and waterproofing the walls to sealing the windows and the roof membrane, every link must be sound. If you focus on one link and neglect the others, water will still get in at the weakest point. The same applies to CCI: from material receipt, sterilization, filling and capping to transport and storage, every step can be a weak point.

blocks.zh: CCI 測試範圍的區別：
blocks.en: Differences in the scope of CCI testing:

blocks.zh: 成品 DP（Drug Product）：常規性 CCI 測試是必要的，通常在批次放行前或安定性研究中執行
blocks.en: Finished drug product (DP): Routine CCI testing is required, usually performed before batch release or in stability studies

blocks.zh: 原料藥 DS 或中間體：僅需一次性確認（one-time qualification），除非風險評估顯示需要更頻繁的測試
blocks.en: Drug substance (DS) or intermediates: Only a one-time qualification is needed, unless the risk assessment shows that more frequent testing is required

blocks.zh: 這個區別很重要，因為它直接影響測試策略的設計和資源分配。
blocks.en: This distinction matters because it directly affects the design of the testing strategy and the allocation of resources.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 特別強調「comprehensive, holistic, and end-to-end」這三個形容詞？它們分別強調了什麼面向？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 specifically emphasize the three adjectives "comprehensive, holistic, and end-to-end"? What aspect does each of them stress?

blocks.zh: 在什麼情況下，DS 或中間體的 CCI 可能需要超越「one-time qualification」，進行更頻繁的測試？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances might the CCI of a DS or intermediate need to go beyond a "one-time qualification" and be tested more frequently?

blocks.zh: 10.2.1 Design and Development of Container Closure 10.2.1 容器封蓋之設計與開發
blocks.en: 10.2.1 Design and Development of Container Closure

blocks.zh: Justified Selection（合理化選擇）：CC 組件的選擇不能只憑經驗或慣例，必須有科學依據的合理化說明。這包括材料相容性數據、功能性測試結果、以及與產品特性的匹配度評估。
blocks.en: Justified selection: The selection of CC components cannot rest on experience or convention alone; it needs a scientifically justified rationale. This includes material compatibility data, functional test results and an assessment of how well the components fit the product characteristics.

blocks.zh: Functional Integrity（功能性完整性）：除了化學相容性之外，CC 系統還必須具備防止微生物進入的物理功能。這是一個經常被忽視但至關重要的面向——許多團隊過度關注化學萃取物/溶出物（E&L）測試，卻忽略了密封功能的驗證。
blocks.en: Functional integrity: Beyond chemical compatibility, the CC system must also have the physical function of preventing microbial ingress. This aspect is often overlooked but is essential: many teams focus too heavily on chemical extractables and leachables (E&L) testing while neglecting verification of the sealing function.

blocks.zh: CC 系統的早期開發就像蓋房子時的建築設計階段。如果在設計圖紙時就考慮好門窗的規格和防水方案，施工時就能順利進行。但如果等房子蓋好了才發現窗戶密封不良，拆除重做的成本會是原來的十倍以上。
blocks.en: Early development of a CC system is like the architectural design stage of building a house. If the door and window specifications and the waterproofing scheme are settled on the drawings, construction goes smoothly. But if poorly sealed windows are found only after the house is built, tearing out and redoing the work costs more than ten times as much.

blocks.zh: 藥品開發也是如此：如果到了臨床試驗階段才發現 CC 系統有問題（例如安定性研究中發現 CCI 失敗），不僅要重新選擇容器、重做相容性研究，還可能需要重做臨床批次——這是巨大的時間和金錢損失。
blocks.en: Drug development is the same: if a problem with the CC system is found only at the clinical trial stage (for example, a CCI failure in a stability study), you must not only select a new container and repeat the compatibility studies, but may also have to repeat the clinical batches, which is a huge loss of time and money.

blocks.zh: 「Early development」的時間點：TR90 明確要求 CC 系統的開發應該在「development phase」就開始，而非等到商業化階段。具體而言：
blocks.en: The timing of "early development": TR90 explicitly requires CC system development to start in the "development phase" rather than waiting for the commercial stage. Specifically:

blocks.zh: 臨床前/Phase I：初步 CC 選擇與相容性篩選
blocks.en: Preclinical/Phase I: preliminary CC selection and compatibility screening

blocks.zh: Phase II/III：CC 系統確認、CCI 測試方法開發
blocks.en: Phase II/III: CC system confirmation and CCI test method development

blocks.zh: 商業化轉移：CC 規格最終確認、CCI 方法驗證
blocks.en: Commercial transfer: final confirmation of CC specifications and CCI method validation

blocks.zh: 越早開始，越能避免後期的法規合規問題和安定性失敗風險。
blocks.en: The earlier you start, the better you can avoid regulatory compliance problems and the risk of stability failures later on.

blocks.zh: CDMO 技術轉移的關鍵考量：當客戶將產品轉移至 CDMO 時，CC 系統的完整技術文件包（包含選擇依據、相容性數據、CCI 測試方法）是技術轉移文件的核心組成部分。如果客戶的 CC 開發不完整，CDMO 需要在接收時識別差距並要求補充，否則可能在製程驗證階段遭遇重大障礙。
blocks.en: Key considerations for CDMO technology transfer: When a client transfers a product to a CDMO, the complete technical documentation package for the CC system (including the selection rationale, compatibility data and CCI test methods) is a core part of the technology transfer documents. If the client's CC development is incomplete, the CDMO must identify the gaps at receipt and ask for them to be filled; otherwise it may meet major obstacles at the process validation stage.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 特別強調 CCI 測試方法的選擇和適用性評估應在產品開發階段就開始？等到商業化階段再做有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 specifically emphasize that the selection of CCI test methods and the assessment of their suitability should begin during product development? What are the risks of waiting until the commercial stage?

blocks.zh: 如果一個客戶帶著只有化學相容性數據但沒有 CCI 功能性測試數據的產品來到 CDMO，你會建議什麼行動計畫？
blocks.en: If a client brings a product to a CDMO with only chemical compatibility data and no functional CCI test data, what action plan would you recommend?

blocks.zh: 10.2.2 Container-Closure Integrity Test Method Development and Method Validation 10.2.2 容器封蓋完整性試驗方法開發與方法驗證
blocks.en: 10.2.2 Container-Closure Integrity Test Method Development and Method Validation

blocks.zh: CCI Specifications（CCI 規格）：包含所有容器組件的尺寸要求、材料要求及其可接受的公差範圍。這些規格是 CCI 管控的基礎文件。
blocks.en: CCI specifications: These cover the dimensional requirements and material requirements for all container components, together with their acceptable tolerances. These specifications are the foundation documents of CCI control.

blocks.zh: CCIT, Container Closure Integrity Test（容器密封完整性測試）：用於驗證 CC 系統密封功能的測試方法。常見方法包括：
blocks.en: CCIT (Container Closure Integrity Test): Test methods used to verify the sealing function of the CC system. Common methods include:

blocks.zh: 真空衰減法（Vacuum Decay）
blocks.en: Vacuum decay

blocks.zh: 高壓放電法（High Voltage Leak Detection, HVLD）
blocks.en: High voltage leak detection (HVLD)

blocks.zh: 氦氣洩漏法（Helium Leak Detection）
blocks.en: Helium leak detection

blocks.zh: 微生物挑戰試驗（Microbial Challenge / Immersion）
blocks.en: Microbial challenge / immersion

blocks.zh: 染料滲透試驗（Dye Ingress）
blocks.en: Dye ingress

blocks.zh: Water Activity（水活性）：產品中可供微生物利用的游離水含量。如果 CC 系統無法阻擋水蒸氣傳輸，產品的水活性可能上升至支持微生物生長的水準，特別是對凍乾產品的影響最為顯著。
blocks.en: Water activity: The amount of free water in the product that is available to microorganisms. If the CC system cannot block water vapor transmission, the water activity of the product may rise to a level that supports microbial growth; the effect is most significant for lyophilized products.

blocks.zh: CCIT 方法的選擇和驗證就像選擇房屋漏水檢測方式。你可以用：
blocks.en: Selecting and validating a CCIT method is like choosing a way to detect leaks in a house. You could use:

blocks.zh: 目視檢查（類似染料滲透試驗）——簡單但可能漏掉微小裂縫
blocks.en: Visual inspection (similar to dye ingress): simple, but may miss tiny cracks

blocks.zh: 紅外線熱像儀（類似真空衰減法）——較敏感，能偵測到肉眼看不見的問題
blocks.en: An infrared thermal camera (similar to vacuum decay): more sensitive, and can detect problems invisible to the naked eye

blocks.zh: 加壓注水測試（類似微生物挑戰試驗）——最接近真實情境，但較耗時
blocks.en: A pressurized water test (similar to microbial challenge): closest to real conditions, but more time-consuming

blocks.zh: 關鍵是：你選的檢測工具必須針對你家的建材和結構做過校準驗證，不能拿別人家的數據直接套用。同理，CCIT 方法必須在實際使用的設備上進行驗證。
blocks.en: The key point is that the detection tool you choose must have been calibrated and validated for your own building materials and structure; you cannot simply apply someone else's data. Likewise, a CCIT method must be validated on the equipment actually used.

blocks.zh: 凍乾產品的特殊風險：Water vapor transmission（水蒸氣傳輸）對凍乾產品是一個關鍵風險因子。凍乾餅體含水量極低，如果 CC 系統允許水蒸氣緩慢滲入，會導致：
blocks.en: Special risks for lyophilized products: Water vapor transmission is a critical risk factor for lyophilized products. A lyophilized cake has very low moisture content, and if the CC system lets water vapor slowly seep in, the result can be:

blocks.zh: 凍乾餅體吸濕崩塌（cake collapse）
blocks.en: moisture uptake and collapse of the lyophilized cake (cake collapse)

blocks.zh: 水活性升高，可能支持微生物增殖
blocks.en: increased water activity, which may support microbial proliferation

blocks.zh: 產品安定性劣化，效期縮短
blocks.en: degraded product stability and a shortened shelf life

blocks.zh: 因此，對凍乾產品而言，CCI 不僅要防止微生物，還要防止水蒸氣——這對密封規格的要求更為嚴格。
blocks.en: For lyophilized products, therefore, CCI must prevent not only microorganisms but also water vapor, which places stricter demands on the sealing specifications.

blocks.zh: 法規參考 Regulatory References
blocks.en: Regulatory References

blocks.zh: 本段提到兩個重要的參考文件：
blocks.en: This section cites two important reference documents:

blocks.zh: PDA TR No. 27：藥品包裝完整性——提供各種 CCIT 方法的全面比較
blocks.en: PDA TR No. 27: Pharmaceutical Package Integrity, which provides a comprehensive comparison of the various CCIT methods

blocks.zh: USP <1207.2>：包裝完整性洩漏測試技術——提供不同測試技術的優缺點分析
blocks.en: USP <1207.2>: Package Integrity Leak Test Technologies, which analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of the different test technologies

blocks.zh: 這些是 CCIT 方法開發和驗證的權威參考指南，從業人員應該熟悉這些文件的內容。
blocks.en: These are the authoritative reference guides for CCIT method development and validation, and practitioners should be familiar with their content.

blocks.zh: Change Control 的預防性思維：TR90 強調必須提供 CC/CCI/CCIT 設計決策的合理化依據（rationale），並將這些數據傳遞給最終的商業製造場所。這在 CDMO 場景中尤其重要：當客戶需要更換容器供應商或修改密封參數時，這些原始設計依據是進行變更評估的基礎。沒有完整的設計依據，任何變更都可能演變成一場法規噩夢。
blocks.en: A preventive mindset toward change control: TR90 stresses that the rationale for CC/CCI/CCIT design decisions must be documented and that this data must be passed on to the final commercial manufacturing site. This matters especially in a CDMO setting: when a client needs to change container suppliers or modify sealing parameters, this original design rationale is the basis for the change assessment. Without a complete design rationale, any change can turn into a regulatory nightmare.

blocks.zh: 為什麼凍乾產品的 CC 系統不僅需要防止微生物進入，還需要防止水蒸氣傳輸？這對 CCI 規格有什麼額外要求？
blocks.en: Why does the CC system of a lyophilized product need to prevent not only microbial ingress but also water vapor transmission? What additional requirements does this place on the CCI specifications?

blocks.zh: 如果你需要為一個新產品選擇 CCIT 方法，你會考慮哪些因素來決定使用確定性方法（如真空衰減）還是概率性方法（如微生物挑戰）？
blocks.en: If you had to select a CCIT method for a new product, what factors would you consider in deciding between a deterministic method (such as vacuum decay) and a probabilistic method (such as microbial challenge)?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 強調 CCIT 方法必須在「實際使用的設備」上進行驗證，而不能僅依賴供應商提供的驗證數據？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 emphasize that a CCIT method must be validated on the "equipment actually used" rather than relying solely on validation data provided by the supplier?

blocks.zh: 10.2.3 Container Closure Integrity During Process Validation 10.2.3 製程驗證期間之容器封蓋完整性
blocks.en: 10.2.3 Container Closure Integrity During Process Validation

blocks.zh: Functional CCI Throughout Shelf Life（效期內的功能性 CCI）：CCI 不是一個一次性的確認——它必須在產品的整個效期內持續維持。這意味著安定性研究方案中應包含 CCI 測試時間點。
blocks.en: Functional CCI throughout shelf life: CCI is not a one-time confirmation; it must be maintained throughout the entire shelf life of the product. This means the stability study protocol should include CCI testing time points.

blocks.zh: Dimensional Variances（尺寸公差）：容器和密封件都有製造公差。製程設計必須能夠在正常公差範圍內（包括最大和最小尺寸組合）都能確保良好的密封效果。
blocks.en: Dimensional variances: Both containers and closures have manufacturing tolerances. The process must be designed to ensure a good seal across the normal tolerance range, including the combinations of maximum and minimum dimensions.

blocks.zh: Worst-case Manufacturing Operations（最差情境製造操作）：CCI 驗證必須在最具挑戰性的製程條件下進行，例如：
blocks.en: Worst-case manufacturing operations: CCI validation must be performed under the most challenging process conditions, for example:

blocks.zh: 容器和膠塞尺寸的極端公差組合
blocks.en: extreme tolerance combinations of container and stopper dimensions

blocks.zh: 最高和最低壓蓋力
blocks.en: maximum and minimum capping force

blocks.zh: 最高充填速度
blocks.en: maximum filling speed

blocks.zh: 儲存條件的極端情境（如運輸過程中的溫度和振動）
blocks.en: extreme storage scenarios (such as temperature and vibration during transport)

blocks.zh: 最差情境驗證就像汽車碰撞測試。汽車製造商不能只在「理想條件」下測試安全性——他們必須在最嚴苛的碰撞角度、最高的測試速度下驗證安全氣囊是否能正常展開。
blocks.en: Worst-case validation is like a car crash test. Automobile manufacturers cannot test safety only under "ideal conditions"; they must verify that the airbag deploys properly at the harshest crash angles and the highest test speeds.

blocks.zh: CCI 驗證也是如此：你不能只用「完美」的容器和膠塞進行測試。你必須找出尺寸公差的極端組合（例如：最大瓶口＋最小膠塞），在最嚴格的製程條件下證明密封仍然完好。如果在最差情境下都能通過，那麼正常情境下就更沒問題了。
blocks.en: CCI validation works the same way: you cannot test only with "perfect" containers and stoppers. You must identify the extreme combinations of dimensional tolerance (for example, the largest vial neck + the smallest stopper) and show that the seal remains intact under the most demanding process conditions. If it passes in the worst case, normal conditions are even less of a concern.

blocks.zh: 製程對 CCI 的潛在影響：TR90 提到 Table 10.2.3-1🔍 列出了需要考量的製程要素。雖然表格內容未在本段詳述，但典型的製程影響因素包括：
blocks.en: Potential effects of the process on CCI: TR90 mentions that Table 10.2.3-1🔍 lists the process elements to be considered. Although the table content is not detailed in this section, typical process factors that affect CCI include:

blocks.zh: 充填參數：充填量、充填速度、針頭位置
blocks.en: Filling parameters: fill volume, filling speed, needle position

blocks.zh: 壓蓋參數：壓蓋力、壓蓋速度、對中精度
blocks.en: Capping parameters: capping force, capping speed, centering accuracy

blocks.zh: 滅菌條件：高壓滅菌的溫度和壓力對容器/膠塞的影響
blocks.en: Sterilization conditions: the effect of autoclave temperature and pressure on containers and stoppers

blocks.zh: 凍乾製程：真空度和壓塞過程中的力學影響
blocks.en: Lyophilization process: vacuum level and the mechanical effects during stoppering

blocks.zh: 運輸條件：振動、溫度變化對已密封產品的影響
blocks.en: Transport conditions: the effect of vibration and temperature changes on sealed products

blocks.zh: 每一個因素都可能在正常製造公差的極端組合下導致 CCI 失敗。
blocks.en: Each of these factors can lead to a CCI failure under extreme combinations of normal manufacturing tolerances.

blocks.zh: 製程驗證中的 CCI 策略：在製程驗證（Process Validation, PV）批次中，CCI 通常作為關鍵的放行測試項目之一。CDMO 應在 PV 方案中明確定義：
blocks.en: CCI strategy in process validation: In process validation (PV) batches, CCI is usually one of the critical release tests. The CDMO should clearly define the following in the PV protocol:

blocks.zh: CCI 測試的取樣計畫（包含最差情境樣品）
blocks.en: The sampling plan for CCI testing (including worst-case samples)

blocks.zh: 可接受標準（acceptance criteria）
blocks.en: The acceptance criteria

blocks.zh: 與 routine CCIT 方法的一致性
blocks.en: Consistency with the routine CCIT method

blocks.zh: 如何證明尺寸公差的極端組合也能達到密封規格
blocks.en: How to demonstrate that the extreme combinations of dimensional tolerance also meet the sealing specification

blocks.zh: 為什麼 CCI 必須在「worst-case manufacturing operations」下進行驗證？如果只在標準條件下驗證通過，有什麼潛在風險？
blocks.en: Why must CCI be validated under "worst-case manufacturing operations"? What are the potential risks if validation passes only under standard conditions?

blocks.zh: 在制定安定性研究方案時，你會在哪些時間點安排 CCI 測試？為什麼？
blocks.en: When drawing up the stability study protocol, at which time points would you schedule CCI testing, and why?

blocks.zh: 如果在製程驗證中發現某個尺寸公差極端組合下 CCI 不合格，你會採取什麼行動？是收緊容器規格還是調整製程參數？
blocks.en: If CCI fails at an extreme dimensional-tolerance combination during process validation, what would you do? Tighten the container specification or adjust the process parameters?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: CC 系統的雙重角色：Container Closure System 必須同時具備「惰性」（不與藥品反應）和「保護性」（防止微生物、微粒、水蒸氣等外界因素）兩個功能
blocks.en: The dual role of the CC system: A container closure system must be both "inert" (not reacting with the drug product) and "protective" (guarding against external factors such as microorganisms, particulates and water vapor)

blocks.zh: 初級 vs 次級包裝：Primary CC 是直接接觸產品的主要屏障，Secondary CC 提供運輸和處理過程中的物理保護
blocks.en: Primary vs secondary packaging: The primary CC is the main barrier in direct contact with the product, while the secondary CC provides physical protection during transport and handling

blocks.zh: Ishikawa 魚骨圖方法論：從材料、設備、製程、量測、環境、人員六大面向系統性分析 CCI 的影響因素
blocks.en: Ishikawa diagram methodology: Systematically analyzes the factors affecting CCI across six dimensions: materials, equipment, process, measurement, environment and people

blocks.zh: 早期開發的重要性：CC 系統的設計和 CCIT 方法的選擇應在產品開發階段就開始，以避免後期的法規合規問題
blocks.en: The importance of early development: CC system design and CCIT method selection should start during product development to avoid regulatory compliance problems later on

blocks.zh: CCIT 方法驗證：必須在實際使用的設備上進行驗證，並參考 PDA TR27 和 USP <1207.2> 的指引
blocks.en: CCIT method validation: Must be performed on the equipment actually used, with reference to the guidance in PDA TR27 and USP <1207.2>

blocks.zh: 凍乾產品的特殊考量：CC 系統不僅要防止微生物進入，還要防止水蒸氣傳輸導致水活性上升
blocks.en: Special considerations for lyophilized products: The CC system must prevent not only microbial ingress but also water vapor transmission, which would raise water activity

blocks.zh: 最差情境驗證：CCI 必須在尺寸公差的極端組合和最嚴格的製程條件下進行驗證
blocks.en: Worst-case validation: CCI must be validated at the extreme combinations of dimensional tolerance and under the most demanding process conditions

blocks.zh: 端到端管控：CCI 是從設計開發到效期結束的完整生命週期管理，不是某個單一環節的工作
blocks.en: End-to-end control: CCI is lifecycle management from design and development to the end of shelf life, not the job of any single step
